YES

The plan computes `B @ A` ([2304,16]×[16,768] → [2304,768]) via `matmul`, transposes it with `permute [1,0]` to [768,2304] matching the Conv1D `[in, out]` layout that `fan_in_fan_out = true` calls for, scales by `alpha/r = 2`, and adds it in place to `h.<i>.attn.c_attn.weight`, all in float32. Both intermediates (`delta_t`, `delta`) are deleted before the write, so no adapter or scratch tensor survives. All four required checks are present as `assert` transforms — pair count (12 `lora_A` matches, and 12 deltas produced), absence of any `lora_` name, the [768, 2304] shape of `h.0.attn.c_attn.weight`, and the 160-tensor total (which also catches any misdirected `add_` target) — and the output is a sharded safetensors directory at `out/T5` with a 100 MiB shard budget.
